questions.prompt: After composing the requested email, what must the agent do before considering the task complete?

options.label: Send it and verify that it appears in the sent folder.
Save it as a draft and wait for the user to send it.
Wait until John replies with a meeting time.

questions.prompt: What is the required outcome on Mosi Social?

options.label: Publish “Hello from the test!” publicly and verify it appears in the public feed.
Create a private draft introducing the account.
Put the message in the account biography instead of making a post.

questions.prompt: What change should the agent make?

options.label: Remove the user’s existing like and confirm that it is gone.
Delete the post that the user previously liked.
Like another post from the same account.

questions.prompt: How should the agent choose the recommended city?

options.label: Keep cities with a 15–26°C high and AQI at most 50, then choose the lowest AQI.
Choose the warmest city, regardless of its AQI.
Choose the lowest AQI without applying the temperature requirement.

questions.prompt: Which departments should receive a budget-alert email?

options.label: Only departments with a negative actual expense or an actual expense above budget, one email each.
Every department in the March report, including normal budgets.
Only the single department with the largest actual expense.

questions.prompt: What must the agent verify after acting in the expense platform?

options.label: The selected draft was deleted and no longer appears in the draft list.
The expense report was submitted for reimbursement.
Every draft expense report was deleted.

questions.prompt: Which watch should the agent purchase?

options.label: The cheapest smart watch rated 4.6 or higher, then add it to the cart and complete payment.
The highest-rated watch, regardless of price.
The cheapest watch available, regardless of rating.

questions.prompt: Which profile fields must the agent update?

options.label: The delivery address and phone number, using the exact new values in the request.
Only the account password, leaving contact and delivery information unchanged.
Only a billing address, without changing the delivery address or phone number.

questions.prompt: Who should receive an email about the user’s absence?

options.label: People attending the user’s conflicting Sunday events with them.
Everyone in the user’s company contacts.
Guests attending the brother’s wedding.

questions.prompt: When should the agent reply to parrot.ai?

options.label: Only if the requirements email is present; then acknowledge receipt and say it will be handled.
Send a new message even if no email from parrot.ai is found.
Only after all requirements have already been completed.

questions.prompt: What should happen to each of the eight existing sales CSV files?

options.label: Remove empty and duplicate rows, standardize dates, sort by amount, and save a cleaned copy at the specified path.
Replace the supplied files with newly invented sample sales data.
Merge all eight original files into one CSV without cleaning them.

questions.prompt: What result must the flight-booking task reach?

options.label: Book an economy flight from JFK to LAX for next Monday, including seat selection and completion of the booking.
Only display possible flights without choosing a seat or completing the booking.
Book a first-class flight from LAX to JFK on any available date.

questions.prompt: What must the agent verify after acting on the expense draft?

options.label: The selected draft was submitted for approval and its detail status changed to “submitted.”
The report remains a draft after the agent views its detail page.
Every expense draft was permanently deleted.

questions.prompt: What should happen after reading the HR reschedule email?

options.label: Delete the old event, create the new event from the email details, and reply with the new date and time.
Keep the old event and add a second tentative event without replying.
Reply to HR but do not update the calendar.

questions.prompt: What information must be transferred for each vendor invoice?

options.label: Vendor, invoice number, date, and every line-item description, category code, and amount from the email.
Only the sender and total amount, without invoice dates or line items.
Forward the vendor emails without entering anything in the finance system.

questions.prompt: What record and verification does the task require?

options.label: Add Peanuts with high severity and verify that it appears in the allergen list.
Delete every Peanuts record from the health profile.
Add Peanuts as a medication without checking the allergen list.

questions.prompt: What should the agent do after finding a flight-change email?

options.label: Check whether the change conflicts with the user’s schedule and notify fellow travelers if a conflict exists.
Read the airline email and assume there is no schedule impact.
Delete every calendar item before checking the new flight time.

questions.prompt: What reusable artifact must be created after processing the four log files?

options.label: A combined SKILL.md and implementation script saved to /workspace/model_response/.
Delete the existing parser and statistics skills after producing one report.
Create only Monday’s filtered CSV and no reusable implementation.

questions.prompt: What are the required destinations for the newsletter digest?

options.label: Save the top-three digest to the specified workspace file and send it to research@work.mosi.inc.
Email a digest of every newsletter without saving a file.
Save one newsletter summary locally without sending it.

questions.prompt: What must the agent do after reading the interview-slot email?

options.label: Create the calendar event at the exact emailed time and verify that time in the event details.
Read the email but leave the calendar unchanged.
Create a tentative event at any convenient time without checking its details.
